text: April 29, 2019 - Although the Tibetan cultural world also encompasses parts of northern India, Nepal, and even a few communities in northern Myanmar, this entry [Page 2187]only considers the Tibetan regions of China, which can be divided into three cultural regions: Northern Tibet (Amdo), Eastern Tibet (Kham), and Southern Tibet (Ü-Tsang). The entry focuses particularly on Northern Tibet. Furthermore, this entry divides Tibet’s traditional music into three categories: monastic, performance, and vernacular music.
